The synthetic requester asks for a pull-on bralette, an unbroken back band, and explicitly excludes a back fastening. The positive realization is the full continuous span of fabric. I choose a back-up tabletop arrangement that makes its edges and continuation visible; ribbing, oatmeal color, the table and light remain author-owned. The image should make structural continuity immediately readable at the saved controls.

A garment study of a pull-on bralette emphasizes its continuous back. The adult-size bralette lies back-up on a smooth ash-wood table. One uninterrupted fabric band runs across the whole back from side seam to side seam. Its upper and lower edges form long parallel curves, while the straps rest above them and the soft cups sit beneath the garment. A gentle turn at one side shows the band continuing around the body opening. The oatmeal ribbed knit carries a fine rhythm of vertical lines across this wide horizontal shape. A softly lit plaster wall rises behind the table. Diffused window light gives the ribbing shallow relief, and the full band span stays sharply readable within a spacious horizontal frame.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.
